name: Brush stroke typed title
what: A worn-tape teaser title: on a dark, noisy ground one line of text types on, a character every 3 frames, over a rough brush stroke that wipes in from the left; thin tech marks, a circuit line and a turning wireframe globe sharpen in around it while the picture slowly zooms.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f2 the first character appears and one more every 3 f; f3-f25 the brush stroke wipes in from the left with a ragged front (fast start, long settle), its ragged edges re-drawing every 10 f; f5-f16 the tech marks, circuit line and globe sharpen in from blur; f3-f170 the ground zooms slowly (15 %, decelerating); the worn-tape speckle changes every frame to the end
